input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase, spend, impression or volume commitment on AP. Services are engaged on a per-Exhibit basis (§1), and §5 (Fees and Payment) is a pure revenue-share on revenue actually generated, with no shortfall, take-or-pay or minimum-guarantee mechanic anywhere (searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall", "volume", "purchase" return only unrelated references — the Winning Bid Price floor AP itself sets (p0014) and the §13 disclaimer that no minimum revenue is guaranteed (p0062)). §1 also confirms the arrangement is non-exclusive and does not restrict AP from selling Inventory through others. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage/ordered services only), so no redline. Noted only for context: §4(a) locks the one-year Initial Term against convenience termination, but since there is no committed spend that lock-in creates no take-or-pay exposure under this rule.
